sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

By means of present writ petition the petitioner has challenged the impugned order dated 26.12.2022 passed by the second respondent/Additional District Magistrate (Nazul)/Adjudication Officer, Meerut in Suit/Case No.2708 of 2021, Computer Case No.D202111520002708 (State of UP vs. Rajendra Kumar) under Section 51 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 by which the penalty of Rs.4,50,000/- has been imposed upon the petitioner.

entities.text: Computer Case No.D202111520002708 (State of UP vs. Rajendra Kumar)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned Standing Counsel has raised a preliminary objection regarding maintainability of the present writ petition on the ground that the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (in short, Act,
2006) is self-contained Act and against the impugned order the petitioner has got efficacious alternative remedy under Section 69 and 70 of the Act, 2006.
Once there is efficacious alternative remedy then the writ petition is liable to be dismissed.
